title: 最小覆盖子串
statement: 给定字符串 s 和 t，返回 s 中最短的连续子串，使 t 中的每个字符（包括重复字符，按出现次数计）都包含在该子串中。如果不存在这样的子串，返回空字符串 ""。测试数据保证答案唯一。

en.title: Minimum Window Substring
en.statement: Given strings s and t, return the shortest contiguous substring of s that contains every character of t (including duplicates, counted by multiplicity). If no such substring exists, return the empty string "". The test data guarantees the answer is unique.
constraints: s and t consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters

complexity.officialRequirement: Official follow-up asks for an algorithm that runs in O(m + n) time.
complexity.notes: m = s.length, n = t.length. Sliding window: expand the right end until t is covered, then shrink the left end as far as possible, tracking how many characters are still missing; each index enters and leaves the window at most once. Comparing all 52 counts on every coverage check is O(52·m), which also passes but is not optimal.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: first line string s; second line string t. stdout: one line, the minimum window substring; print an empty line if none exists.

constraints: s 和 t 由大小写英文字母组成

complexity.space: O(|Σ|) 额外空间（字符计数，|Σ| = 52）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方 follow-up 要求设计 O(m + n) 时间的算法。
complexity.notes: m = s.length，n = t.length。滑动窗口：右端扩张直到覆盖 t，再尽量收缩左端，并记录仍缺的字符数量；每个下标最多进出窗口各一次。每次检查是否覆盖都比较 52 个计数的做法为 O(52·m)，也可通过但不是最优。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行字符串 s；第二行字符串 t。stdout：一行，最小覆盖子串；不存在时输出空行。
